description.title: Description
description.heading: A captain's house, facing the sea
description.content:
Facing the sea, this magnificent house of character, south-facing, is an authentic long-haul captain's house, on the island of Batz. Every room opens onto the sea, and the enclosed garden that surrounds it leads to the beach in 50m, 5 minutes from the ferry terminal.

Everything here is conducive to relaxation: reading in front of a good fireplace, children playing in the garden or on the beach in complete peace, walks along the wild coast, long evenings of board games.

agencement.title: Layout
agencement.heading: Four bedrooms, a sea view from every floor

item1.title: Ground Floor
item1.content: Large living room. Fully equipped kitchen (dishwasher, microwave, oven, coffee maker, kettle, toaster, espresso machine, bread maker). Pantry (washing machine, dryer). Bathroom

list.item2: 1 bedroom with 1 double bed (120 cm) + balcony
list.item3: 1 bedroom with 1 double bed (140 cm) + 2 single beds (80 cm)

carte.hook: Sheltered from the wind, 5 minutes from the ferry landing, the house looks out to sea from the tip of the island.
